speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. You presented with right groin pain and abnormal leg positioning after a rear-end collision; can you describe exactly how the accident occurred and the specific mechanism of injury?

speaker: Patient
text: 25-year-old female. The patient was involved in a rear-end collision where she was the restrained driver of the back car. She reports immediate onset of pain in both knees and severe pain over the right groin area following the accident.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Posterior dislocation of the right knee.

The mechanism of injury—being the restrained driver in the back car of a rear-end collision—is classic for hyperextension injuries leading to posterior dislocation. I will proceed to confirm the physical findings and rule out associated vascular or neurological compromise.
